d: Jet black hair is styled in an elegant updo with a sheer black veil covering the eyes, featuring a small white floral accent. The eyes are narrow and sharp in a pale, light-blue shade, set upon a mature, sophisticated face. The build is slender and tall, dressed in a backless navy-blue gown with sheer sleeves and emerald gem accents, draped with a heavy crimson red shawl. Accessories include a delicate silver chain descending the back and emerald earrings.
